zh.title: 波音787-10搭GEnx發動機 廣體客機油耗評比奪冠
zh.summary: 根據《Aircraft Commerce》針對14種廣體客機與發動機組合進行的燃油消耗評比，搭載GEnx發動機的波音787-10夢幻客機在評比中高居首位，在燃油表現上擊敗了其餘13種廣體客機與發動機搭配組合。
body: 根據《Aircraft Commerce》進行的一項研究評比，該機構針對14種廣體客機機體與發動機的搭配組合進行了燃油消耗排名。這項分析涵蓋了多種廣體航空器與發動機組合的燃油消耗數據。
評比結果顯示，搭載GEnx發動機的波音787-10（Boeing 787-10）夢幻客機在所有參評項目中名列第一。搭載GEnx發動機的波音787-10在燃油消耗表現上擊敗了其餘13種廣體客機與發動機組合。
新聞媒體《Simple Flying》於2026年8月3日報導了這項研究成果，指出在《Aircraft Commerce》針對14種廣體航空器發動機與機體組合的燃油評比中，配備GEnx發動機的787-10型號位居首位。

en.title: GEnx-Powered Boeing 787-10 Ranks First in Widebody Fuel Burn Study
en.summary: A comparative fuel burn study conducted by Aircraft Commerce evaluated 14 widebody engine-airframe combinations across the commercial airline sector. According to ranking details reported by aviation news outlet Simple Flying on August 3, 2026, the Boeing 787-10 Dreamliner aircraft powered by GEnx engines achieved the top position overall. The GEnx-powered Boeing 787-10 Dreamliner came first in fuel burn efficiency, outperforming 13 other widebody engine and airframe combinations assessed in the study.
body: According to a study conducted by Aircraft Commerce, a total of 14 widebody engine-airframe combinations were ranked based on their fuel burn performance. The study evaluated fuel burn characteristics across these specific widebody aircraft and engine configurations.

The findings established that the GEnx-powered Boeing 787-10 Dreamliner achieved the top position. The GEnx-powered Boeing 787-10 came first in the fuel burn ranking, outperforming 13 other widebody engine-airframe combinations evaluated in the Aircraft Commerce study.

This comparative fuel burn ranking was reported by Simple Flying on August 3, 2026, detailing that the GEnx-powered Boeing 787-10 Dreamliner placed first among the 14 widebody engine and airframe combinations assessed.
